title: peucedanum typicum
intro: Peucedanum typicum, commonly known as Chinese angelica or Qian hu, is a type of perennial plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving cough, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum typicum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins. The bioactive constituents of Peucedanum typicum may also have anti-cancer and anti-bacterial properties, making it a valuable plant in natural medicine.
